imgready engine tests

Every case here is a behaviour that was wrong at some point. The engine's recurring failure mode is producing a file of the wrong kind and reporting success, so the assertions read actual bytes, magic numbers, ICO directory entries, decoded frame counts, rather than trusting a label.

    Runs against the real worker over HTTP, so it must be served rather than opened from disk. Fixtures are generated in the browser, no binary files to keep in sync. Headless: await window.IMGREADY_TESTS.run()
